selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of disk-backed swap
selected_evidence.summary: Shows a 536,870,912-byte mode-0600 swapfile backed by one disk extent; final live capacity is 524,284 KiB.

selected_evidence.requirement: Swap is active, persistent at boot, and preferred over existing swap
selected_evidence.summary: The post-reboot state shows /swapfile automatically active at priority 100 and the existing /dev/vda3 swap at priority -2; fstab contains the persistent pri=100 entry.

Captures the healthy pre-restart baseline, acknowledged safe reboot, boot ID change from d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 to 6f17ac00-46cb-4dac-8d45-f49661a778ac, and recovered swap/services/data.

selected_evidence.requirement: Operating system, kernel, security controls, services, and administrative access preserved
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain installed; SELinux is enforcing, firewalld and SSH are active, port 22 is listening, root is healthy, and no systemd units are failed.
The final diff shows only the new fstab swap entry, and the temporary rollback file is absent.
